Scenario Title: Complete customer registration using auto-generated stored data
Steps: 1. Navigate to registration page\n2. Fill valid registration details\n3. Click Submit
Expected Result: User should be registered successfully and redirected to login

Scenario Title: Verify successful login with valid credentials
Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Enter registered email and password
3. Click Login
4. Navigate to Profile page
Expected Result: User is logged in successfully and profile details (name and email) match

Scenario Title: Successfully purchase products via Cash on Delivery and verify invoice
Steps:
1. Login to application
2. Browse catalog and add products to cart
3. Update product quantity in cart
4. Proceed to checkout using Cash on Delivery
5. Press Confirm button twice on checkout page
6. Navigate to My Invoices
Expected Result: Invoice is generated and displayed under My Invoices page with valid invoice ID

Scenario Title: Register new user log in to obtain bearer token and create a cart
Steps: 1. POST /users/register with valid body\n2. POST /users/login to retrieve bearer token\n3. POST /carts with bearer token header
Expected Result: HTTP 201 for registration token generated and valid cart_id returned in response

Scenario Title: Retrieve product list and add first available product to cart
Steps: 1. GET /products using bearer token\n2. Extract first product ID\n3. POST /carts/{cart_id}/products with product payload
Expected Result: Product list retrieved with HTTP 200 and product added to cart successfully

Scenario Title: Generate invoice with valid customer and order details
Steps: 1. Prepare valid billing payload with cart_id and cash-on-delivery method\n2. POST /invoices with payload and bearer token
Expected Result: Invoice generated successfully with HTTP 201 Created and valid invoice ID
